english.title: Driver fail to initial correction in drivers record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having made a correction in a drivers' record book pursuant to regulation 8(8) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987, failed to initial it
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(8) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.
